Hello everyone,

I am back again with some kitbash bits.

This kit includes:

- Cadian, Elysian & DKOK:
 - Lasguns
 - Autoguns
 - Special Weapons

- Aquilons & Kasrkin Weapons
- Lots of backpacks & Grav Chutes
- Various other bits (pouches, explosives etc.)

All objects with Imperial Aquilas also come with a variant without it.
These files come unsupported as they are meant to be digitally kitbashed.

I have included Vox Backpacks & Kasrkin Backpacks without the antennas so you can put Copper wire in there. I sized them to fit 1,5mm² wire.

Files are scaled for 28mm minis.
Please mind the license I put this kit up with, ask me beforehand if you want to post something with these files in it.

Hope you´ll enjoy these!
